sv.title: Trump landar i Filippinerna – polisen har gripit demonstranter
sv.summary: USA:s president Donald Trump landar i dag i Asien. Hans resa börjar i Filippinerna och besöket kantas redan av protester. Inför presidentens ankomst har polisen i Manila gripit hundratals demonstranter som protesterat mot Pax Silica – den USA-ledda pakten som syftar till att säkra leveranskedjor…

en.title: Trump lands in the Philippines – police have arrested protesters
en.summary: US President Donald Trump lands in Asia today. His trip begins in the Philippines and the visit is already marked by protests. Ahead of the president's arrival, police in Manila have arrested hundreds of demonstrators who protested against Pax Silica – the US-led pact that aims to secure supply chains…
